tools.Name: Hermes Agent
tools.Description: A self-improving AI agent with a built-in learning loop that can run on various infrastructures, from low-cost VPS to clusters.
tools.Use_Case: Automating complex tasks and building self-improving AI agents with cross-platform continuity.

tools.Name: VoiceStudio
tools.Description: An open-source, local-first alternative to ElevenLabs that supports voice cloning, dubbing, and transcription in 646 languages.
tools.Use_Case: Local, private audio production, voice cloning, and video dubbing without API dependency.

tools.Name: SkillSpector
tools.Description: A security scanner designed to detect vulnerabilities and malicious patterns in AI agent skills before they are installed.
tools.Use_Case: Auditing and securing third-party AI skills for prompt injection, data exfiltration, and supply-chain risks.
